    option = {
        name = oe_ecc.30.c
        trigger = { has_variable = oe_ecc_offer_3 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_ecc.30.c.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_pick value = 3 }
            oe_ecc_shift = { hes = 0 rat = 0 uni = 4 }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { var:oe_ecc_dom ?= 0 } NOT = { var:oe_ecc_dom ?= 3 } }
                oe_ecc_auth = { amount = -5 }
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ecc_pat_rift years = 5 mode = replace }
            }
            c:PAP ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ecc_union_pleased target = c:BYZ } }

            trigger_event_silently = oe_ecc.31
        }
        ai_chance = {
            base = 10
            modifier = { factor = 3 oe_ecc_union_talks = yes }
            modifier = { factor = 2 var:oe_ecc_dom ?= 3 }
        }
    }

    immediate = { oe_ml_take_as = { line = 14 } c:WAL ?= { save_scope_as = oe_ecc_wal } }
    option = {
        name = oe_ecc.60.a
        custom_tooltip = oe_ecc.60.a.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            oe_ecc_see_set = { see = wal value = 1 }
            scope:oe_ecc_wal ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ecc_consecrated target = c:BYZ } }
            oe_ecc_pres_add = { amount = 3 }
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 85 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_ecc.60.b
        trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_60_once } }
        custom_tooltip = oe_ecc.60.b.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            scope:oe_ecc_wal ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ecc_slighted target = c:BYZ } }
            set_variable = oe_ecc_60_once
            set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_60_wait years = 3 }
            remove_variable = oe_ecc_done_60
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 15 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_ecc.60.c
        trigger = { has_variable = oe_ecc_60_once }
        custom_tooltip = oe_ecc.60.c.tt
        hidden_effect = { scope:oe_ecc_wal ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ecc_slighted target = c:BYZ } } }
        ai_chance = { base = 15 }
    }
}

    option = {
        name = oe_ecc.80.a
        custom_tooltip = oe_ecc.80.a.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            oe_ecc_pres_add = { amount = -1 }

            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_ecc_rus_host }
                set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_alms_from value = scope:oe_ecc_rus_host }
                scope:oe_ecc_rus_host = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ecc.81 }
            }
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 85 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_ecc.80.b
        add_legitimacy = legitimacy_weak_bonus
        ai_chance = { base = 15 }
    }
}

oe_ecc.81 = { # 君士坦丁堡的求援信
    type = country_event
    outcome = neutral
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/society/religion.dds"
    title = oe_ecc.81.t
    desc = oe_ecc.81.desc
    trigger = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_ecc_alms_v } }
    option = {
        name = oe_ecc.81.a
        custom_tooltip = oe_ecc.81.a.tt
        add_gold = { value = c:BYZ.var:oe_ecc_alms_v multiply = -0.5 }
        add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
        hidden_effect = {
            c:BYZ = {
                set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_alms_got value = var:oe_ecc_alms_v }
                trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ecc.82 days = 90 }
            }
        }
        ai_chance = {
            base = 50
            modifier = { factor = 2 opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 50 } }
            modifier = { factor = 0.3 opinion = { target = c:BYZ value < 0 } }
        }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_ecc.81.b
        custom_tooltip = oe_ecc.81.b.tt
        add_gold = { value = c:BYZ.var:oe_ecc_alms_v multiply = -0.25 }
        hidden_effect = {
            c:BYZ = {
                set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_alms_got value = var:oe_ecc_alms_v }
                change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_alms_got multiply = 0.5 }
                trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ecc.82 days = 90 }
            }
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 40 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_ecc.81.c
        custom_tooltip = oe_ecc.81.c.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            c:BYZ = {
                oe_ecc_pres_add = { amount = -2 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_alms_got value = 0 }
                trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ecc.82 days = 90 }
            }
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 10 modifier = { factor = 3 opinion = { target = c:BYZ value < 0 } } }
    }
}

oe_ecc.82 = { # 北方来的银子
    type = country_event
    outcome = positive
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/trade_market/trade.dds"
    title = oe_ecc.82.t
    desc = {
        first_valid = {
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { has_variable = oe_ecc_alms_got var:oe_ecc_alms_got > 0 } desc = oe_ecc.82.desc.a }
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { always = yes } desc = oe_ecc.82.desc.b }
        }
    }
    trigger = { tag = BYZ has_variable = oe_ecc_alms_got }
    immediate = { oe_ml_take_as = { line = 14 } }
    option = {
        name = oe_ecc.82.a
        trigger = { has_variable = oe_ecc_alms_got var:oe_ecc_alms_got > 0 }
        add_gold = var:oe_ecc_alms_got
        hidden_effect = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_alms_total } }
                set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_alms_total value = 0 }
            }
            change_variable = { name = oe_ecc_alms_total add = var:oe_ecc_alms_got }
            remove_variable = oe_ecc_alms_got
            remove_variable = oe_ecc_alms_v
            remove_variable = oe_ecc_alms_from
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 100 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_ecc.82.b
        trigger = { NOT = { AND = { has_variable = oe_ecc_alms_got var:oe_ecc_alms_got > 0 } } }
        hidden_effect = {
            remove_variable = oe_ecc_alms_got
            remove_variable = oe_ecc_alms_v
            remove_variable = oe_ecc_alms_from
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 100 }
    }
}
